prayerExcerpt.en-US: May we imitate his constancy in the faith.

meta.face: A Tuscan of about sixty-five, worn thin by the long journey and the prison, with a ROUNDED-TRIANGULAR face — a broad, low forehead and wide, flat temples tapering past softly drawn cheeks to a short, narrow chin; a straight nose with a wide, flat bridge; round, gentle, pale-brown eyes that droop a little at the outer corners, under thin grey brows raised in patient sorrow; a small, soft mouth; grey hair cut in a round Roman tonsure fringe and a short, neat grey beard trimmed to a small point; a meek, steady gaze.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; art shows him behind prison bars, and the reliquary bust at Coimbra gives him only a conventional short beard. He died of ill-treatment in Theodoric's prison at Ravenna in 526, after his embassy to Constantinople, so the face is ours: worn, meek and patient, with a different shape from the other popes' cards.
